name: Paving, curbs & walks
notes: Anchored on state DOT weighted-average bid prices (FDOT statewide 12-month Sep 2025-Aug 2026; ArDOT Jun 2025-Jun 2026; MDT calendar 2025). DOT prices are for public right-of-way work bid in large quantities under DOT specifications (traffic control, testing, prevailing wages on federal-aid jobs); private parking-lot work is usually smaller quantity but lighter spec, so DOT unit prices are used as the anchor and assembled into typical private-site sections in each method. Values are contractor prices in place.

items.name: Asphalt paving, parking/drive section (≈3" HMA on ≈8" aggregate base, incl. subgrade prep)

cost.method: Assembled from FDOT 12-month statewide weighted averages: HMA Superpave Traffic C $136.23/ton (e1) x 0.165 ton/SY for 3" (110 lb/SY-in) = $22.5/SY; aggregate base (FDOT optional base groups 01-09 $17.50-$25.46/SY, e2) ~$20/SY; subgrade prep, prime/tack and proof-roll allowance ~$3/SY -> ~$45/SY mid. Low $30 = 2" HMA on 6" base in large flat lots; high $70 = 4" HMA on 10" base in small quantities/remote markets. MDT 2025 plant mix (e12) excludes binder so is used only as a cross-check that DOT mix prices span $60-$150/ton across states.

items.notes: ≈$5.00/SF at mid. Heavy truck areas: use heavy-duty-concrete or add 1-2" HMA. Excludes curb, striping, storm drainage.

items.name: Concrete paving, standard (5-6" PCC on base; parking, drives, walks at vehicle areas)

cost.method: FDOT 6" plain cement concrete pavement $82.00/SY (single contract, e7) and ArDOT P.C. concrete base 6" weighted average $67.98/SY on 12,085 SY (e8). Mid $75 = midpoint of the two DOT 6" prices; low/high = ArDOT 6" range adjusted for private-lot quantities and base course.

items.notes: ≈$8.30/SF at mid. Includes jointing, forming, finishing and base. Excludes reinforcement beyond typical fiber/WWF and curbs.

items.name: Heavy-duty concrete paving (7-9" PCC; truck courts, dumpster pads, loading aprons)

cost.method: FDOT plain cement concrete pavement 9" $169.84/SY (4 contracts, 15,523 SY) and 10" $140.37/SY (e7); ArDOT PCC pavement 12" $145.86/SY (e8). Highway thicknesses exceed typical private heavy-duty sections (7-8"), so mid $115 = 6" price (~$75) scaled by thickness (8/6 x $75 = $100) plus doweling/reinforcement allowance (~$15). High = FDOT 9" weighted average.

items.notes: ≈$12.80/SF at mid. For distribution/industrial truck courts and drive-thru lanes.

items.name: Gravel / crushed-aggregate road or lot (≈8" compacted aggregate on prepared subgrade)

cost.method: MDT 2025 crushed aggregate course weighted average $45.38/CY on 325,970 CY (e10). 8" = 0.222 CY/SY x $45.38 = $10.1/SY; add subgrade shaping, geotextile and compaction ~$3-5/SY -> mid $15. Low = 6" section with local pit-run (MDT traffic gravel $15.96/CY); high = 10-12" section with geotextile in markets without nearby quarries.

items.notes: RV/boat storage, rural access drives, overflow lots, construction roads.

items.name: Private road, 24' two-lane asphalt with curb & gutter both sides

cost.method: Per LF of centerline: 24' of asphalt = 2.67 SY/LF x $45/SY (asphalt-paving mid) = $120; curb & gutter both sides 2 x $38/LF (curb-gutter mid, FDOT/ArDOT e4/e5) = $76; roadway subgrade/fine grading ~$25; storm drainage allowance (inlets ~every 300 ft at ~$10k each per FDOT curb inlet prices + pipe) ~$60; striping/signage ~$5 -> ~$286, rounded to $300 mid. Low = thinner section, inverted-crown drainage; high = thicker section, more drainage structures, smaller jobs. Excludes sidewalks, street lights and water/sewer mains (see utilities block).

items.notes: Internal subdivision / campus / RV park loop road. Add sidewalk (sy) and utilities separately.

items.name: Concrete curb & gutter (standard 2' section)

cost.method: FDOT Type F $38.56/LF (146 contracts, 314,814 LF) and Type E $35.45/LF (e4); ArDOT curb & gutter-A $31.25/LF on 84,431 LF (e5). Mid $38 = FDOT Type F (largest sample); low = ArDOT weighted average less ~10% for long machine-placed runs; high = small hand-formed quantities (ArDOT range tops at $100/LF).

items.notes: Use ~2 LF per LF of two-sided road; parking islands add ~0.5-1.0 LF per space.

items.name: Concrete sidewalk, 4" (and 6" at driveways via high end)

cost.method: FDOT concrete sidewalk and driveways 4" $67.93/SY (123 contracts, 146,864 SY) and 6" $94.98/SY (e3); ArDOT concrete walks $92.13/SY on 33,130 SY (e6). Mid $72 = FDOT 4" price weighted with the ArDOT walk price; high = 6" sections / ArDOT; low = large private-site pours.

items.notes: ≈$8/SF at mid. 5' walk = 0.56 SY per LF.

items.name: Parking stall striping, wheel stop excluded (per space)

cost.method: FDOT thermoplastic, white, solid 6" for parking spaces $2.94/LF (e9). One stall needs ~18-20 LF of stall line plus a share of end/aisle markings ~20-25 LF -> $59-$74 thermoplastic (high). Painted (waterborne) striping, the norm on private lots, runs roughly 1/3-1/2 of thermoplastic -> $15-$35. Mid $35 assumes paint plus a share of ADA symbols/arrows.

items.notes: Add ADA stall signage/symbols (~$300-$600 per accessible stall) and wheel stops (~$75-$150 each) if required.
